SELECT TOP 10
    -- 53
    YEAR(TXN_DTE) AS YEAR,

    --54
    MONTH(TXN_DTE) AS TXN_MO,

    --55

    --56
    -- **unfinalized joinkey**
    --GROUPGB.GB_GROUP,

    --57
    CASE WHEN TXN_POS_ENTRY_MODE IN (10, 100, 800, 810) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ONLINE_TAG,

    --58 to 59 **unfinalized joinkey**
    --MC.MERCHANT_CATEGORY,
    --MC.SPEND_CATEGORY,

    --60
    --CASE WHEN GS.GB_SUBGROUP1 = 'BALANCE CONVERSION DEBIT' THEN
    --CASE WHEN SUBSTR(GS.TXN_DESC, 1, 4) = 'SPEC' THEN 'SIP'
    --WHEN SUBSTR(GS.TXN_DESC, 1, 4) = 'TRAN' THEN 'TRANCON'
    --WHEN SUBSTR(GS.TXN_DESC, 1, 4) = 'BALA' THEN 'BALCON' ELSE GS.GB_SUBGROUP1 END
    --ELSE GS.GB_SUBGROUP1 END AS GB_SUBGROUP_FIN

    --61
    CASE WHEN TXN_PDT_NBR IN (101, 102, 103, 104, 105) THEN 'PRIME'
    WHEN TXN_PDT_NBR IN (202, 203, 204, 205) THEN 'PLATINUM'
    WHEN TXN_PDT_NBR IN (201, 206, 207, 208, 209) THEN 'CASH REWARDS'
    WHEN TXN_PDT_NBR IN (210, 211) THEN 'FREEDOM'
    WHEN TXN_PDT_NBR IN (301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306) THEN 'WORLD'
    WHEN TXN_PDT_NBR IN (308, 309, 310) THEN 'WEALTH' END AS PRODUCT_TYPE,

    -- 62
    COUNT(TXN_CARD_NBR) AS TRAN_COUNT,

    --63

    --64
    
    --65
    COUNT(DISTINCT TXN_ACCT_NBR) AS CNT_UNIQ_ACCTS

FROM d360.STG_CCD_CBCEXCTDBP

--INNER JOIN (SELECT TransactionTypeId, GB_GROUP FROM #REF# ) GROUPGB ON CBCEXCTDBP.TXN_CODE = GROUPGB.TransactionTypeId
--INNER JOIN (SELECT MCC CODE, MERCHANT_CATEGORY, SPEND_CATEGORY, GB_SUBGROUP1, DESC FROM #REF# ) MC ON CBCEXCTDBP.TXN_CODE = MC.MCC CODE
--INNER JOIN(SELECT TransactionTypeId, GB_SUBGROUP1, TXN_DESC FROM #REF#) GS ON CBCEXCTDBP.TXN_CODE = GS.TransactionTypeId

GROUP BY
    YEAR(TXN_DTE),
	MONTH(TXN_DTE),
	TXN_DESC,
	--GB_GROUP, 
	TXN_POS_ENTRY_MODE,
	--MERCHANT_CATEGORY,
	--SPEND_CATEGORY,
	--GB_SUBGROUP_FIN,
	TXN_PDT_NBR,
    TXN_CARD_NBR
